confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Vientiane price levels for July 2026. I did not check live listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation tiers. The FX value is taken from a search summary that attributes 0.6955 to the RBA exchange-rates page for 15 October 2026. The raw results I received did not show that figure, and one search summary described the RBA page as showing only March 2026 data, so the FX provenance is unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian basis, benchmarked against budget-to-mid-range capitals and tourist towns in mainland SE Asia (Phnom Penh, Hanoi, Luang Prabang), adjusted for Vientiane's generally lower restaurant and guesthouse prices. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from the beer anchor (wine about 4.5 times beer, cocktail about 3.5 times beer) because direct knowledge of bar prices is weak.
